name: PHP with PostgreSQL
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'echo "host all all 127.0.0.1/32 md5" >> /etc/postgresql/*/main/pg_hba.conf && echo "local all all trust" >> /etc/postgresql/*/main/pg_hba.conf && sudo service postgresql start && sleep 5 && sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE appdb;" || true && sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER appuser WITH PASSWORD \"password\";" || true && sudo -u postgres psql -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE appdb TO appuser;" || true && sudo -u postgres psql -d appdb -c "GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO appuser;" && sudo -u postgres psql -d appdb -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO appuser;" && sudo -u postgres psql -d appdb -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL SEQUENCES IN SCHEMA public TO appuser;" && sudo -u postgres psql -d appdb -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL ON TABLES TO appuser;" && sudo -u postgres psql -d appdb -c "ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT ALL ON SEQUENCES TO appuser;" && cd /workspace/php-postgres-app && export DB_HOST=localhost DB_NAME=appdb DB_USER=appuser DB_PASSWORD=password && php -d xdebug.mode=off src/init_db.php && php -d xdebug.mode=off src/run_migration.php'
